name: User
rationale: A generic principal entity is needed because requirements refer to users and subjects with combinations of roles.
plain_english_summary: A person using the gradebook system.
source_excerpt: No user should be able to both receive and assign external grades through any combination of roles.

name: Student
rationale: Student is a role-like entity type used for role membership checks on principals.
plain_english_summary: The role for users who are students.
source_excerpt: Students receive external grades but must not assign external grades.

name: Faculty
rationale: Faculty is a role-like entity type used for role membership checks on principals.
plain_english_summary: The role for users who are faculty members.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can assign internal grades and external grades.

name: TeachingAssistant
rationale: TeachingAssistant is a role-like entity type used for role membership checks on principals.
plain_english_summary: The role for users who are teaching assistants.
source_excerpt: Teaching assistants can view and assign internal grades, but teaching assistants must not view or assign external grades.

name: FacultyFamily
rationale: FacultyFamily is a role-like entity type used for role membership checks on principals.
plain_english_summary: The role for members of the faculty family group.
source_excerpt: Members of the Faculty Family role can receive external grades.

name: Grade
rationale: A common grade resource type is needed for requirements that refer to assigning grades without distinguishing internal from external grades.
plain_english_summary: A grade record in the gradebook.
source_excerpt: If a subject is a faculty member, that subject may assign grades.

name: InternalGrade
rationale: InternalGrade is a distinct grade resource category with different permissions from external grades.
plain_english_summary: A grade used internally by the institution or teaching staff.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can assign internal grades and external grades.

name: ExternalGrade
rationale: ExternalGrade is a distinct grade resource category subject to receive/assign separation and faculty responsibility requirements.
plain_english_summary: A grade that is externally visible or externally assigned in the scenario.
source_excerpt: Students receive external grades but must not assign external grades.

name: Course
rationale: Course is the resource type needed for enrollment requirements.
plain_english_summary: A course that a non-faculty subject may enroll in.
source_excerpt: If a subject is not a faculty member, then permit that subject to enroll in courses.

name: assignInternalGrade
rationale: This action represents assigning an internal grade resource.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can assign internal grades and external grades.

name: assignExternalGrade
rationale: This action represents assigning an external grade resource.
source_excerpt: Students receive external grades but must not assign external grades.

name: viewInternalGrade
rationale: This action represents viewing an internal grade resource.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can view internal grades and external grades.

name: viewExternalGrade
rationale: This action represents viewing an external grade resource.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can view internal grades and external grades.

name: receiveExternalGrade
rationale: This action represents receiving an external grade resource.
source_excerpt: Members of the Faculty Family role can receive external grades.

name: enrollInCourse
rationale: This action represents enrolling in a course resource.
source_excerpt: If a subject is not a faculty member, then permit that subject to enroll in courses.
